Description: CloudHub chaos experiment (API outage) with stop condition and automatic rollback

LifecycleStateMachineArn.Description: Workflow whose failures abort the experiment

Properties.AlarmDescription: Stop condition: a real environment workflow failed during the experiment

Properties.DefinitionString: {"Comment": "CloudHub chaos experiment: API outage with stop condition and rollback", "TimeoutSeconds": 900, "StartAt": "ValidateInput", "States": {"ValidateInput": {"Type": "Choice", "Choices": [{"And": [{"Variable": "$.duration_seconds", "IsNumeric": true}, {"Variable": "$.duration_seconds", "NumericGreaterThanEquals": 30}, {"Variable": "$.duration_seconds", "NumericLessThanEquals": 600}], "Next": "AddGuards"}], "Default": "InvalidInput"}, "InvalidInput": {"Type": "Fail", "Error": "InvalidInput", "Cause": "duration_seconds must be 30-600"}, "AddGuards": {"Type": "Pass", "Parameters": {"duration_seconds.$": "$.duration_seconds", "guard_alarms.$": "$$.Execution.Input.guard_alarms", "elapsed": 0}, "ResultPath": "$", "Next": "ReadBaseline"}, "ReadBaseline": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:lambda:getFunctionConcurrency", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "${TargetFunction}"}, "ResultPath": "$.baseline", "Next": "BaselineFree"}, "BaselineFree": {"Type": "Choice", "Choices": [{"Variable": "$.baseline.ReservedConcurrentExecutions", "IsPresent": true, "Next": "BaselineHasReserved"}], "Default": "GuardBefore"}, "BaselineHasReserved": {"Type": "Fail", "Error": "PreconditionFailed", "Cause": "Target already has reserved concurrency; rollback could not restore it exactly"}, "GuardBefore": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:cloudwatch:describeAlarms", "Parameters": {"AlarmNames.$": "$.guard_alarms", "StateValue": "ALARM"}, "ResultSelector": {"firing.$": "States.ArrayLength($.MetricAlarms)"}, "ResultPath": "$.guard", "Next": "GuardsQuiet"}, "GuardsQuiet": {"Type": "Choice", "Choices": [{"Variable": "$.guard.firing", "NumericGreaterThan": 0, "Next": "GuardAlreadyFiring"}], "Default": "InjectFault"}, "GuardAlreadyFiring": {"Type": "Fail", "Error": "PreconditionFailed", "Cause": "A guard alarm is already in ALARM"}, "InjectFault": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:lambda:putFunctionConcurrency", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "${TargetFunction}", "ReservedConcurrentExecutions": 0}, "ResultPath": "$.injected", "Catch": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "ResultPath": "$.error", "Next": "RemoveFault"}], "Next": "Hold"}, "Hold": {"Type": "Wait", "Seconds": 15, "Next": "CheckGuards"}, "CheckGuards": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:cloudwatch:describeAlarms", "Parameters": {"AlarmNames.$": "$.guard_alarms", "StateValue": "ALARM"}, "ResultSelector": {"firing.$": "States.ArrayLength($.MetricAlarms)"}, "ResultPath": "$.guard", "Catch": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "ResultPath": "$.error", "Next": "RemoveFault"}], "Next": "StopOrContinue"}, "StopOrContinue": {"Type": "Choice", "Choices": [{"Variable": "$.guard.firing", "NumericGreaterThan": 0, "Next": "StopConditionMet"}], "Default": "Tick"}, "StopConditionMet": {"Type": "Pass", "Result": "stop condition: guard alarm fired", "ResultPath": "$.stopped", "Next": "RemoveFault"}, "Tick": {"Type": "Pass", "Parameters": {"duration_seconds.$": "$.duration_seconds", "guard_alarms.$": "$.guard_alarms", "baseline.$": "$.baseline", "elapsed.$": "States.MathAdd($.elapsed, 15)"}, "Next": "DurationReached"}, "DurationReached": {"Type": "Choice", "Choices": [{"Variable": "$.elapsed", "NumericGreaterThanEqualsPath": "$.duration_seconds", "Next": "RemoveFault"}], "Default": "Hold"}, "RemoveFault": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:lambda:deleteFunctionConcurrency", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "${TargetFunction}"}, "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "IntervalSeconds": 2, "BackoffRate": 2, "MaxAttempts": 6}], "ResultPath": null, "Next": "VerifyRestored"}, "VerifyRestored": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:lambda:getFunctionConcurrency", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "${TargetFunction}"}, "ResultPath": "$.after", "Next": "Restored"}, "Restored": {"Type": "Choice", "Choices": [{"Variable": "$.after.ReservedConcurrentExecutions", "IsPresent": true, "Next": "RestoreFailed"}, {"Variable": "$.stopped", "IsPresent": true, "Next": "StoppedByGuard"}, {"Variable": "$.error", "IsPresent": true, "Next": "ErrorRolledBack"}], "Default": "Completed"}, "RestoreFailed": {"Type": "Fail", "Error": "RestoreFailed", "Cause": "Reserved concurrency still set; restore manually"}, "StoppedByGuard": {"Type": "Fail", "Error": "StopConditionMet", "Cause": "Guard alarm fired; fault removed early"}, "ErrorRolledBack": {"Type": "Fail", "Error": "ExperimentError", "Cause": "Fault removed after an error"}, "Completed": {"Type": "Succeed"}}}

{"Comment": "Safety net: remove the injected fault if the experiment was aborted or timed out", "StartAt": "RemoveFault", "States": {"RemoveFault": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:lambda:deleteFunctionConcurrency", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "${TargetFunction}"}, "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "IntervalSeconds": 2, "BackoffRate": 2, "MaxAttempts": 6}], "End": true}}}
